headline: How to fish in Palworld 1.0
title: How to Fish in Palworld | Rods, Bait and the Fishing Minigame | Palworld Guide
video_script: Palworld one point zero added fishing! Here's how to start. Open your Technology menu and unlock the fishing set, which you can get from around level fifteen. Craft a fishing rod and some bait. Then look for fish shadows in the water and cast near them. When a fish bites, a minigame starts: move the green bar to keep the fish inside it until the meter fills. Each cast uses one bait, and better rods and bait unlock as you level up. Caught anything rare yet? Comment below!

scenes.fact: Keep the fish in the bar
scenes.sub: Fill the meter to catch it
